versions.subject: Merge PR #5525 from @swachchhanda000 - WinRAR Creating Files in Startup Locations - CVE-2025-6218 and CVE-2025-8088
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\WinRAR.exe'
        - '\Rar.exe'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\'
condition: selection
